newsitem.title: USA: Most PS Oklahoma preferred tendered - CSW.
newsitem.headline: Most PS Oklahoma preferred tendered - CSW.

text.p: Central and South West Corp said Friday that 73 percent of Public Service Co of Oklahoma's preferred stock and 31 percent of Southwestern Electric Power Co's preferred stock had been tendered in response to its offer for the shares, which expired Wednesday.
According to a preliminary count, 52,957 PS Oklahoma 4.0 percent shares and 91,934 of the 4.24 percent shares were tendered, It said.
It said 52,514 of Southwestern Electric's 4.28 percent shares, 23,034 of the 4.65 percent shares, 36,411 of the 5.0 percent shares, and 41,990 of the 6.95 percent shares were tendered.

Special meetings of shareholders of PS Oklahoma and Southwestern Electric were held Wednesday, at which amendments to the companies' Restated Certificates of Incorporation were adopted, eliminating a provision limiting the amount of unsecured debt issued by each company, Central and South West said.
Central and South West holds all the common stock of both companies.
